surface_mechanism_description: The catalytic effect of AlO films permits Si atoms to be incorporated into the films. The adsorption probability of TMA molecules may be higher than that of TEOS molecules when they adsorb on AlSi xOy films. Competitive adsorption between the two species, i.e., TMA and TEOS molecules, occurs in the process. The catalytic effect of AlO films on the growth of SiO films rather than that of SiO films on the growth of AlO films.
evidence: In the case of depositing PEALD Al2O3 films, the TMA and O2 plasma were alternately supplied into the reactor. At a growth temperature of 150°C, a growth rate of 0.158 nm per cycle was obtained. In order to incorporate Si atoms in films, TMA and TEOS were used as precursors and were supplied to the reactor separately. The catalytic effect of AlO films on the incorporation of Si atoms is caused by Al metal. The adsorption probability of TMA molecules may be higher than that of TEOS molecules when they adsorb on AlSi xOy films. Competitive adsorption between the two species, i.e., TMA and TEOS molecules, occurs in the process. The catalytic effect of AlO films on the growth of SiO films rather than that of SiO films on the growth of AlO films.
